content: Tailwind CSS v4 (latest 4.3.x) uses a first-party Vite plugin @tailwindcss/vite instead of PostCSS+autoprefixer config; add tailwindcss() to vite.config plugins and  in the main CSS entry. No tailwind.config.js required by default — theme customization now happens via @theme in CSS, though a JS config can still be pulled in via @config for gradual migration.
